caseName: Mountain States Telephone & Telegraph Co. v. Pueblo of Santa Ana
caseNameFull: Mountain States Telephone & Telegraph Co. v. Pueblo of Santa Ana

opinions.text:
C. A. 10th Cir. Motions of Atchison, Topeka & Santa Fe Railway Co. and Public Service Company of New Mexico for leave to file briefs as amid curiae granted. Certiorari granted. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief in this casé expressing the views of the United States.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions and this petition.
